instruction: Export the image as 'river_of_dreams.jpg' to the Documents folder.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully exported image via File > Export As dialog, changed filename to export.jpg, navigated JPEG quality options, and completed export in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP menus, use Export As dialog, change filenames, handle JPEG export options, navigate file system within dialogs.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests navigation to a different directory (Documents instead of Desktop) in the Export As dialog. Agent must change the target folder, adding complexity to the proven export workflow.
metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting to /home/user/Documents/ instead of Desktop. Evaluator uses vm_command_line with 'file' command to verify the exported file exists in Documents and is a valid JPEG.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly runs 'file /home/user/Documents/river_of_dreams.jpg' to check the exported file at the exact path and filename specified in the instruction.
Metric check_include_exclude correctly verifies the file is a valid JPEG by checking for 'JPEG image data' in the file command output.
Exclude patterns 'cannot open' and 'No such file' properly detect when the file does not exist.
Complete coverage: file location (Documents folder), filename (river_of_dreams.jpg), and format (JPEG) are all verified by a single well-designed evaluator step.
